title: Xokleng - Wikipedia
text: The Xokleng or Aweikoma (sometimes called botocudos) are an Indigenous tribe of Brazil; their territory is located mainly in the state of Santa Catarina. They were one of the original inhabitants of Misiones Province in Argentina.
